name: Erase Sampled Color tool removes color family shades to transparency while preserving outlines
description: When a user selects the Erase Color tool (Shift+R) with Color Family active and clicks a visible color, exact and related shades are erased to transparency while dark contours and other colors remain untouched.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Select the pen tool in the left toolbar
Choose a bright pink drawing color from the palette
Draw a circular patch of pink pixels on the canvas
Choose a dark outline color
Draw an outline enclosing the pink patch
Select the Erase Color tool with eyedropper and checkerboard icon in the left toolbar
Verify the tool options rail displays the Erase Color settings with tolerance slider, matching mode, and Color Family toggle set to On
Click on the pink patch inside the outlined area
Verify the pink pixels are erased to transparent canvas while the dark outline contour remains intact
Click the Undo button in the top toolbar
Verify the erased pink artwork is fully restored within the outline

name: Erase Sampled Color with All Frames scope clears matching color across animation frames
description: Switching Erase Color scope to All Frames removes the clicked sampled color on the corresponding unlocked layer across every frame in the project animation timeline.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Select the pen tool in the left toolbar
Choose an orange drawing color
Draw an orange mark on the center of frame 1
Click the Add blank frame button in the timeline to create frame 2
Draw an orange mark on frame 2 at the same location
Select the Erase Color tool in the left toolbar
Click the frame scope button in the tool options rail to switch from This frame to All frames
Click on the orange mark in the center of the canvas
Verify the orange mark on frame 2 is erased to transparent canvas
Select frame 1 in the bottom timeline
Verify the orange mark on frame 1 was also removed across the animation timeline

name: Analyze and Crisp Artwork scans active layer for faint alpha and specks with before and after previews
description: Opening the PixiTools inspector and scanning artwork with Analyze & Crisp Artwork reports counts of faint alpha, specks, and color bands, and displays side-by-side Before and Preview thumbnails.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Select the brush tool in the left toolbar
Draw artwork with varying stroke opacity on the canvas
Open the PixiTools inspector in the right sidebar
Expand the Pixel Cleanup & RotSprite section
Verify the Analyze & Crisp Artwork assistant panel is visible with Faint alpha slider, Shades toggle, and Scan Artwork button
Click the Scan Artwork button
Verify a status summary appears detailing detected faint pixels, hardened alpha, and color counts
Verify side-by-side Before and Preview artwork cleanup thumbnails are displayed

name: Apply Artwork Cleanup hardens semi-transparent pixels and supports undo restoration
description: Applying the analyzed sprite cleanup bakes crisp solid pixels into the active layer, and triggering Undo restores the original semi-transparent artwork.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Select the pen tool in the left toolbar
Draw a small sprite shape with soft edges on the canvas
Open the PixiTools inspector in the right sidebar
Expand the Pixel Cleanup & RotSprite section
Click the Scan Artwork button in the Analyze & Crisp Artwork panel
Click the Apply Cleanup button
Verify the cleanup report updates to confirm the changes have been applied to the layer
Click the Undo button in the top toolbar
Verify the canvas reverts to the original pre-cleanup state without error

name: Bucket fill tolerance and enclosed specks options fill nearby shades and enclosed color specks
description: Setting the Bucket tool tolerance slider fills similar color values across contiguous regions, and enabling Enclosed specks clears tiny isolated detail specks inside the fill.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Select the pen tool in the left toolbar
Draw a dark circular boundary with a small pale shade variation inside
Select the Bucket tool in the left toolbar
Verify the tool options rail displays the Bucket fill tolerance slider and Enclosed specks button
Adjust the Bucket fill tolerance slider to 40
Click the Enclosed specks button to toggle it On
Choose a vibrant teal color from the palette
Click inside the circular boundary to fill
Verify the entire enclosed region including the shade variation is filled with uniform teal color

name: Color Replace with active layer tolerance slider replaces shades while respecting locked layers
description: The Color Replace tool replaces exact or nearby shades on the active layer based on its tolerance slider, while skipping transparent pixels and locked background layers.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Select the pen tool in the left toolbar
Choose a deep red drawing color
Draw a red stroke on the base layer
Open the Layers panel in the right sidebar
Add a new layer above the base layer
Choose a lighter coral red drawing color
Draw a coral stroke on the new layer
Click the lock button on the base layer to lock it
Select the Color Replace tool in the left toolbar
Verify the tool options rail displays the Color Replace tolerance slider
Adjust the Color Replace tolerance slider to 30
Choose a bright yellow replacement color from the palette
Click the coral red stroke on the active layer
Verify the coral stroke on the active layer turns yellow
Verify the red stroke on the locked base layer remains completely red and unchanged

name: RotSprite 45-degree rotation preserves outline contours and color boundaries
description: Rotating a circular sprite with a dark outline and light interior by 45 degrees preserves the exterior contour without dark blotches inside or outline breaks.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Select the ellipse tool in the left toolbar
Choose a light cyan color and enable filled shape
Draw a centered filled circle leaving generous margin from canvas edges
Choose a dark navy outline color and disable filled shape
Draw a concentric circular border surrounding the light cyan circle
Open the PixiTools inspector in the right sidebar
Expand the Pixel Cleanup & RotSprite section
Set the rotation angle slider to 45 degrees
Click the Rotate Cleanly button
Verify the rotated silhouette maintains a solid dark perimeter around the light cyan interior
Verify no stray dark pixels appear inside the cyan fill and no cyan pixels breach the outer margin

name: RotSprite rejects rotation safely when artwork would extend outside canvas bounds
description: Attempting a 45-degree RotSprite rotation on artwork positioned at the canvas borders triggers an explanatory clipping warning and leaves the original pixels untouched.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Select the pen tool in the left toolbar
Draw a stroke directly touching the top-left edge of the canvas
Draw a stroke directly touching the bottom-right edge of the canvas
Open the PixiTools inspector in the right sidebar
Expand the Pixel Cleanup & RotSprite section
Set the rotation angle slider to 45 degrees
Click the Rotate Cleanly button
Verify an informative notification toast explains that the rotation would clip the artwork
Verify both corner strokes remain in their exact original canvas positions

name: Lasso selection hover remains inert and irregular masked Delete leaves unselected artwork intact
description: Moving the cursor over canvas with the Lasso tool selected does not paint preview artifacts, and deleting an irregular selection removes only enclosed pixels.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Select the pen tool in the left toolbar
Draw a distinct mark on the left side of the canvas
Draw a second distinct mark on the right side of the canvas
Select the Lasso tool in the left toolbar
Move the mouse across the canvas without holding any button
Verify neither mark is modified and no preview lines or stray pixels appear on the canvas
Click and drag an irregular lasso loop around only the left mark
Press the Delete key
Verify the left mark is completely deleted while the right mark remains fully intact
Verify no lingering lasso selection lines or border artifacts remain on the canvas

name: Blank frame creation retains layer names and properties with empty isolated artwork
description: Adding a blank frame from the timeline creates new empty layers inheriting existing layer names, preventing edits on the new frame from modifying the original frame.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Select the pen tool in the left toolbar
Draw a stroke on the base layer of frame 1
Open the Layers panel in the right sidebar
Add a new layer and rename it to Shading
Draw a separate stroke on the Shading layer
Click the Add blank frame button with plus icon in the bottom timeline
Verify the bottom timeline activates frame 2
Verify the Layers panel lists both the base layer and Shading layer with clean blank canvas
Draw a new test stroke on frame 2
Select frame 1 in the bottom timeline
Verify frame 1 retains both original strokes and does not contain the stroke drawn on frame 2

name: Layer visibility lock opacity and blend mode edits create structural Undo steps
description: Changing layer properties such as opacity, blend mode, visibility, and lock state creates reversible structural history steps without corrupting canvas pixel data.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Select the pen tool in the left toolbar
Draw a simple character sprite on the canvas
Open the Layers panel in the right sidebar
Adjust the Layer opacity slider from 100 percent to 50 percent
Change the Layer blend mode dropdown from Normal to Multiply
Click the Hide layer eye button to make the layer invisible
Verify the layer artwork is hidden on the canvas
Click the Undo button in the top toolbar
Verify the layer visibility is restored and the artwork reappears
Click the Undo button again
Verify the Layer blend mode reverts back from Multiply to Normal
Click the Undo button a third time
Verify the Layer opacity slider reverts back to 100 percent

name: Active frame duration input updates timeline card layout and reverts via Undo
description: Modifying the active frame duration in milliseconds updates the timeline card width and duration label, and triggering Undo restores the prior duration value.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Click the Add blank frame button in the bottom timeline to create frame 2
Verify frame 2 displays the default duration label in the timeline
Click the Active frame duration input field in the bottom timeline bar
Type 350 into the duration input field
Click outside the duration input field to commit the value
Verify the frame 2 card in the timeline updates its width and displays 350ms
Click the Undo button in the top toolbar
Verify the frame 2 duration reverts back to its default duration value

name: Import modal Sprite Sheet Slicer configures cell grid dimensions with cutline preview
description: Opening the Import dialog, choosing Sprite Sheet Slicer, and adjusting cell dimensions renders an interactive cutline grid over the sheet and enables slicing into animation frames.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Click the Import button in the top atelier rail
Verify the Import Modal opens displaying file source selection
Choose the Sprite Sheet Slicer mode option
Verify slicer dimension inputs for Cell Width, Cell Height, and frame ordering appear
Enter 32 for cell width and 32 for cell height
Verify the slicer cutline preview canvas renders grid lines dividing the sprite sheet into cells
Verify the Slice and Import Frames button is active and displays frame count

name: Export modal Animated tab validates safe dimensions and displays safety limits
description: Navigating to the Animated tab in the Export modal verifies scale choices, uncompressed frame memory constraints, and user warning feedback when limits are approached.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Select the pen tool and draw a small icon on the canvas
Click the Export button in the top atelier rail
Verify the Export modal opens with PNG, Animated, Sprite Sheet, and Project tabs
Click the Animated tab
Verify format options for GIF, APNG, MP4, and WebM are available
Verify resolution scale buttons show safe multipliers up to allowed memory ceilings
Switch between GIF and APNG formats
Verify the export configuration panel calculates estimated file dimensions and enables the Export Action button

name: Studio workspace renders focused atelier layout without obsolete music radio widget
description: Verifying the atelier header, rail, canvas, inspector, and status bar shows responsive editor tools and clean workspace without leftover audio controls or broken dependencies.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://pixibun.vercel.app/studio
Verify the top atelier rail contains project title, zoom controls, undo and redo buttons, and action modals
Verify the left vertical toolbar displays drawing tools, eraser, bucket, color replace, erase color, shapes, and eyedropper
Verify the center drawing canvas renders with pixel grid and checkerboard transparency background
Verify the right inspector panel displays Tabs for Layers, Palette, and PixiTools
Verify the bottom status bar displays canvas dimensions, cursor coordinate indicators, and no music player widgets
